Corridor of the Index
食指的走廊

dataList.content:
I'm not quite used to this weapon form yet...
我对这把武器的操作还不够熟练。

So I may have made you suffer needlessly.
看来给你带来了许多不必要的痛苦。

Mal... function...?
为什么……没能击发……

That's not my doing. I didn't have any reason to prepare a trap like that.
这可不怪我。我没有理由准备那种陷阱。

You should've taken better care of your weapons when you had the time. Weapons that fail when they actually matter... are no weapons at all.
平时就该好好保养武器啊。关键时刻掉链子的武器……形同虚设。

No need to overthink it.
不必多想。

Fortune happened to land on my side—that's all there is to it.
就当是我走运吧，这么想对你好些。

I suppose all that's left is to wait?
只需要等待了吧？
